# Button

```tsx
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para executar uma ação com um clique e comunicar o que acontecerá em seguida.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Surface
  inverse={args.inverse}
  fill={context.viewMode === "story" ? "canvas" : "block"}
>
  <StoryButton {...args} />
</Surface>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Button Primary / Secondary / Ghost components. Inverse=True is `inverse` for Button Ghost and `secondary-inverse` for Button Secondary. Hover and Pressed are an overlay painted by ::after on top of the fill, like the stacked fills in Figma; -z-10 inside `isolate` keeps it under the label.
- The Secondary strokes are Inside in Figma: an inset ring, so they take no room (the other variants have no stroke).
- Icons and the spinner take the Figma Icon variables (Icon/On Color, Button/.../Icon, Icon/Disabled), not the label's Text ones.

## Variants

`buttonVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `primary`, `secondary`, `secondary-inverse`, `ghost`, `inverse` | `primary` |
| `size` | `sm`, `md`, `lg` | `md` |
| `iconOnly` | `true`, `false` | `false` |
| `danger` | `true`, `false` | `false` |

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`Button`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loading?` | `boolean` | Replaces the icons with a spinner and ignores clicks, like State=Loading. |

## Rules

- Import `Button` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
